title: Umuzana w'Intebe wihuse
intro: Mu rugo rw'umutegetsi ukomeye, hasabwe ikintu kidashoboka, kandi benshi bahatanira kugaragaza agaciro kabo. Nyamara, icyo gikorwa cyashoboraga gukorwa gusa n'umuntu ufite isano n'ubumenyi bw'Imana irenze ubuhanga bwose bw'umubiri, agahishura umwanya washoboraga kugaragara mu bihe bitandukanye.
clues: Nari mu murimo w'umwami ukomeye wari n'umuhanuzi, kandi nari mu itsinda rye ryizewe cyane.
Ntabwo nari ikiremwa cy'umuriro cyangwa ikiremwa gifite imbaraga nyinshi, ariko nari mfite ikintu gikomeye cyane kurusha icyo.
Igihe umwami yasabaga ko intebe y'ubwami ituruka mu gihugu cya kure izana, nari nzi neza icyo gukora.
Navuze ku bumenyi nari mfite mu gitabo, kandi mbere y'uko umuntu wese agira icyo akora, intebe y'ubwami yashyizwe imbere y'umwami.
Igikorwa cyanjye ntabwo cyabaye ku bubasha bwanjye bwite, ahubwo cyari ikimenyetso cy'uko ubumenyi nyakuri buturuka kuri Allah wenyine.
Ni njye wazanye intebe y'Umwamikazi w'i Sheba mu kanya nk'ako guhumbya, nk'uko byanditswe muri Surah An-Naml.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
